data.summary:
Results-driven Senior Technical Project Manager and Scrum Master with 20 years of IT experience, including 10+ years in Agile Delivery, Project Management and Scrum Leadership across Assurance, Banking, Payments, Capital Markets, and Microsoft technology Programs.
Proven track record of leading cross-functional distributed teams, driving sprint execution, PI planning, release governance, stakeholder management, risk/dependency management, budgeting, forecasting, and client delivery for global organizations including EY, HSBC, Microsoft, and Morgan Stanley. Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, Aha!, Agile metrics, and delivery reporting.
Certified CSM, SAFe Agilist, Google Cloud Digital Leader, and Generative AI Leader, with growing focus on AI-enabled delivery transformation and modern program management.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
GLOBANT INDIA PVT. LTD. – Pune, India
Senior Technical Project Manager / Scrum Master / Delivery Manager | Feb 2022 – Present
Client: EY (Ernst & Young) Project: EY Virtual App Store Domain: Assurance / Legal & Compliance Technology

Lead end-to-end Agile delivery for EY Neo POD supporting a legal and compliance platform focused on digital transformation, anomaly detection, and regulatory compliance.
Manage one Agile POD of 14 cross-functional team members within an overall 70+ member program, coordinating delivery across multiple geographies and time zones.
Drive quarterly release planning and execution, ensuring alignment of sprint goals, milestone commitments, and

stakeholder expectations across distributed teams. Improved delivery turnaround time by strengthening sprint execution, backlog readiness, dependency tracking, and release governance.
Oversee project financial operations for a Multi million $ engagement, including budgeting, costing, revenue tracking, margin monitoring, forecasting, and invoicing.
Facilitate Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and stakeholder demos to maintain delivery cadence and team alignment.
Partner with Product Managers, Business Analysts, Architects, and engineering teams to prioritize roadmap items, refine features and user stories, and align delivery with business objectives.
Drive delivery visibility and governance through Azure DevOps dashboards, velocity tracking, burndown reporting, defect monitoring, and executive status reporting.
Support PI planning, capacity planning, risk/issue management, dependency management, and quarterly business reviews to improve predictability and stakeholder confidence.
Enabled faster release cycles and continuous flow of changes through adoption of a Continuous Delivery Pipeline

(CDP) and disciplined Agile delivery practices. Lead people management activities including hiring support, onboarding/offboarding, mentoring, performance feedback, career discussions, and conflict resolution.
Ensure adherence to Agile best practices, Scrum principles, and organizational delivery governance standards while supporting high-quality, predictable client delivery.
Environment: Azure DevOps, Aha!, .NET, Angular, Azure App Services, Microservices, CI/CD
CAPGEMINI INDIA PVT. LTD. – Pune, India
Scrum Master / Engagement Manager | Oct 2011 – Jan 2022
Project: POL – Payments Orchestration Layer
Client: HSBC | Domain: Banking Payments | Duration: Jan 2021 – Jan 2022
Led Agile POD delivery across Hong Kong, Singapore, and Thailand for a payments orchestration platform supporting MVP milestones aligned to ISO 20022 adoption.
Facilitated Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups to ensure smooth sprint execution and alignment with release objectives.
Worked on payment orchestration initiatives supporting SWIFT payment flows and ISO 20022 migration for HSBC Payments platforms.
Managed backlog planning, sprint tracking, delivery reporting, and Agile metrics using Jira and Confluence to improve delivery visibility and governance.
Monitored velocity, burndown, defect trends, and backlog health to improve sprint predictability, transparency, and release readiness.
Coordinated cross-POD planning, stakeholder demos, and knowledge-sharing sessions across distributed teams and business stakeholders.
Tracked and mitigated risks, issues, and dependencies through RAID management and proactive stakeholder follow-ups.
Environment: Jira, Confluence, Java, Spring Boot, Kubernetes, Kafka, Oracle, Git, Jenkins, Postman, REST APIs
Project: LCRF – Large Corporate Receivable Finance
Client: HSBC | Domain: Commercial Banking | Duration: Oct 2018 – Dec 2020
Served as Scrum Master for a 20-member Agile team delivering a Straight-Through Processing (STP) solution for supplier invoice and credit note processing via HSBCNet.
Drove Agile Scrum adoption and coordinated delivery across Business, Transformation, and Technology teams to support milestone execution and business objectives.
Facilitated Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives while partnering with the Product Owner on backlog prioritization and user story readiness.
Managed Jira dashboards, sprint metrics, and delivery reporting to provide visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and release readiness.
Supported business walkthroughs, sprint demos, user validation activities, and stakeholder communication across the end-to-end delivery lifecycle.
Contributed to team onboarding, engagement, and continuous improvement initiatives, helping strengthen Agile ways of working and team collaboration.
Environment: Jira, Confluence, Java, Spring Boot, ReactJS, REST APIs, Oracle, Git, Jenkins, Postman, TOSCA
Project: GSP – Global Services Platform
Client: HSBC | Domain: Retail Banking | Duration: Jan 2016 – Sep 2018

Led the Move Money and HK FPS Agile POD as Scrum Master, delivering functionality for real-time 24x7 payments and retail banking services.
Facilitated Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews / Demos, Retrospectives, and Scrum of Scrums to support sprint execution and release alignment.
Supported requirement analysis, backlog refinement, sprint execution, and stakeholder reporting across business and technology teams.
Managed Jira / Confluence delivery artifacts, sprint metrics, and Agile reporting to improve delivery governance, transparency, and progress visibility.
Removed delivery impediments and supported team onboarding, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration to strengthen Agile ways of working within the POD.
Environment: RTC, Quality Center, Jira, Confluence, Git, Jenkins, Maven, Postman, REST Client
QA Manager / Test Lead – Morgan Stanley
Client: Morgan Stanley | Domain: Capital Markets | Duration: Oct 2011 – Dec 2015

Led QA delivery and quality assurance activities for capital markets applications, including test planning, execution management, defect tracking, release support, and stakeholder communication.
Managed test teams, quality reporting, and release readiness activities, ensuring adherence to delivery timelines and quality standards.
Built strong experience in SDLC execution, delivery governance, cross-functional coordination, and stakeholder reporting, which supported later transition into Agile delivery leadership roles.
MINDTREE LTD. – Pune, India
QA Lead / Test Analyst | Sep 2005 – Sep 2011
Worked across enterprise applications and Microsoft platforms, progressing through QA and test leadership roles.
Key assignments included:
Morgan Stanley – SDR Herald | Capital Markets | QA Manager ● Microsoft Musiwave, France | Web Application | Test Specialist ● Microsoft Windows Azure, USA | Cloud Platform | Module Lead ● Windows Live OneCare, Microsoft USA | Web & Desktop Application | Test Analyst
Highlights:

Led QA planning, test execution, defect management, and release validation for enterprise web, desktop, and cloud-based products.
Built a strong foundation in SDLC, quality engineering, stakeholder coordination, and release readiness that later strengthened delivery and project management capabilities.
